page.layout: One column of running text at the top, with a small heading above it. Below the text is a three-column table (Nomen, Figura, Potestas) with sub-headings "In fine, In medio, In initio". Small notes sit in the right margin beside rows 5 and 6. Row 7 is cut off at the bottom of the scan.

main_text.head: SECT. I. Alphabetum Persicum.
main_text.p: Consonantes quas vocant; easdem habent Persæ cum Arabibus, ejusdemque figuræ, ordinis, et in plerisque, potestatis: quatuor vero literas Alphabeto Arabico addunt, ut ex subjecta tabula liquet.
main_text.l: In fine | In medio | In initio
1 | Elif | ـا | ـا | ا | Spirit. lenis.
5 | Se | ـث [?] | ـثـ [?] | ثـ [?] | S Angl.
6 | Gjim | ـج | ـجـ | جـ | G Gall.

page.notes: The table figures are Arabic-script letter forms; the small diacritics (dots) in several cells are read approximately and marked [?] where unsure. Row 7 (Che) is cut off at the bottom of the scan, so its figures and potestas are not shown. The "Angl." and "Gall." annotations are small marginal notes beside rows 5 and 6. Long s is printed as f in the original and is transcribed as s.
